name: Tangkak Merdeka Half Marathon 2026
short_description: A 21.1 km half-marathon held at Dataran Tangkak, Tangkak, Johor, Malaysia on August 16, 2026, with registration now closed.
ai_summary: The Tangkak Merdeka Half Marathon 2026 is a half-marathon event scheduled for August 16, 2026, held at Dataran Tangkak in Tangkak, Johor, Malaysia. The race offers a 21.1 km distance for participants. Registration for this event is currently closed, so those interested in running will need to look out for future editions.
pros: Takes place at a clear, named venue: Dataran Tangkak, Johor
Offers a standard, well-defined half-marathon distance of 21.1 km
Set on a specific, confirmed date of August 16, 2026
cons: Registration status is listed as closed, limiting entry for interested runners

excerpt_quotes.quote: Tourism Johor pun dah keluarkan kenyataan bagi 3 acara SoldOut Event. Iskandar Johor Half Marathon Kluang Half Marathon Tangkak Merdeka Half Marathon · Rosak semua sebab organizer ni.
Whatsapp tak reply dah, kita call pula number not in service..
excerpt_quotes.attribution: Update post on the event's official Facebook page

research_highlights: This is billed as Tangkak's first-ever Merdeka Half Marathon (2026 is the inaugural edition), so there is no prior-year course or logistics track record to reference.
Race offers three distances — 21KM, 10KM and 5KM — starting/finishing at Dataran Tangkak, Johor on Sunday 16 August 2026.

The event is organised by SoldOut Events, the same technical organiser behind the Iskandar Johor Half Marathon and Kluang Half Marathon, which were named together in a Tourism Johor statement amid runner complaints.
research_watchouts: Tourism Johor reportedly issued a public statement concerning three SoldOut Events races (Iskandar Johor HM, Kluang HM, and Tangkak Merdeka HM) after community complaints, with one poster saying everything was 'rosak' (ruined) because of this organiser.
An official event Facebook update noted communication problems, stating the organiser's WhatsApp was not being answered and their phone number was out of service.
No first-hand participant race reports (course conditions, crowd support, heat, cut-offs) were found, since this is a brand-new, not-yet-run event.

faqs.question: When is the Tangkak Merdeka Half Marathon 2026?
faqs.answer: The Tangkak Merdeka Half Marathon 2026 is scheduled to take place on August 16, 2026. This date is confirmed as part of the race's core facts, marking it as an event held around the Malaysian Merdeka period in Tangkak, Johor, Malaysia.

faqs.question: What distance is offered at this race?
faqs.answer: The Tangkak Merdeka Half Marathon 2026 offers a single primary distance of 21.1 kilometers, which is the standard half-marathon distance. This makes it a straightforward event for runners specifically seeking a half-marathon distance challenge in Johor, Malaysia.

faqs.question: Can I still register for this race?
faqs.answer: According to the available information, registration for the Tangkak Merdeka Half Marathon 2026 is currently listed as closed. Interested runners will not be able to sign up for this edition at this time and should watch for updates on future registration openings.

faqs.question: Where does the race take place?
faqs.answer: The Tangkak Merdeka Half Marathon 2026 is held at Dataran Tangkak, located in Tangkak, Johor, Malaysia. This venue serves as the starting point for the event, situated in the Tangkak area of Johor state within Malaysia.
